responsibility: This file implements the coroutine lowering passes that expand coroutine-specific builtins and internal functions in GIMPLE. It first rewrites library-facing builtins such as coro.promise, coro.resume, coro.destroy, and coro.done into explicit pointer arithmetic, loads, indirect calls, or tests on the coroutine frame; it also lowers IFN_CO_SUSPN to gotos and performs early CFG-oriented expansion of coroutine internal functions like CO_YIELD and CO_ACTOR, rewriting hidden coroutine control-flow labels and switch/branch structure into executable CFG form for later optimization and expansion.
